extDescription.message: Nulavio built-in components: new tab, search and profile settings, and the dangerous-download warning.

headline.message: The web is yours. So is your data.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search with your default search engine

filterDisabled.message: uBlock Origin is off. To turn it on: ☰ menu → Add-ons and themes

filterMissing.message: No filter installed (tracking protection still applies)

passwordsNone.message: Browser password manager off and no external manager active

statusNote.message: Read just now from the browser settings. Nothing is sent to Nulavio.

broken1.message: Open the uBlock Origin button and turn it off for this site only. Turn it back on the same way.

broken2.message: Click the shield next to the address to relax tracking protection for this site.

broken3.message: On HTTP-only sites, HTTPS-Only mode asks before continuing; the exception is per site and can be removed in Settings.

footer.message: Nulavio is built on Mozilla's Gecko engine. Nulavio is not affiliated with Mozilla.

footerLimits.message: A browser cannot protect against malware already running on this computer.

warnBody.message: This file can run programs on your computer. Open it only if you trust whoever published it.

warnDanger.message: Safe Browsing flagged this download as dangerous. We recommend deleting it.

warnDeleteFailed.message: Could not delete the file. It may already have been moved or removed.

warnMissing.message: This download was not found. It may have been removed from the downloads list.

warnWhy1.message: Installers and scripts (AppImage, .sh, .run, .deb, .rpm, Flatpak and others) run with your account's permissions and can read your files and open sessions.

warnWhy2.message: Nulavio never opens these files by itself and saves them without execute permission.

warnWhy3.message: This browser does not check download reputation with Google. Before opening, check the source and, if the author publishes one, the signature or checksum.

settingsIntro.message: These settings belong to this profile. Nothing is sent to Nulavio.

settingsNeedsBuild.message: These settings need the Nulavio build. In this browser, use Settings → Search.

searchEnginesNote.message: Type an alias such as @ddg before your search in the address bar to use that engine once.

engineSuggestOn.message: On: what you type is sent to $HOST$ while you type.

engineSuggestOff.message: Off: nothing is sent until you search.

engineRemoveBody.message: It leaves your list of search engines in this profile. Engines that come with the browser can be restored in the browser's Settings → Search.

suggestPrivateLabel.message: Also show suggestions in private windows

suggestPrivateNote.message: Only from engines with suggestions turned on above.

addProvidersNone.message: All of them are in your list.

addProviderKagiNote.message: Kagi is a paid service; you sign in on kagi.com.

addSearxngNote.message: Use an instance you run or trust. Nulavio never picks a public instance for you.

addCustomUrl.message: Search address, with %s where the search goes

addOpenSearchNote.message: Nulavio downloads this file once to read the engine's addresses.

err_needs_https.message: Use an https:// address (http:// only for this computer).

err_credentials_in_url.message: Remove the user name or password from the address.

err_invalid_alias.message: Aliases use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (up to 20).

err_alias_taken.message: Another engine already uses this alias.

err_name_taken.message: That name is already in use.

err_suggest_other_host.message: The suggestions address must be on the same site as the search address.

err_last_engine.message: Keep at least one search engine.

err_not_found.message: Not found. The list was refreshed.

err_in_use.message: That profile is open. Close its windows, then try again.

err_is_current.message: Delete the profile you are using from its own page.

err_unexpected.message: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

profilesIsolation.message: Each profile has its own cookies, history, passwords and extensions. Signing in to a site in one profile does not sign you in to the others.

profilesUnavailable.message: Switching profiles works when Nulavio starts from its menu entry. This window was started with a profile folder (--profile), so it is not available here.

profilesDisabled.message: Profiles are turned off in this browser (browser.profiles.enabled).

profilesTemplatesNote.message: A template only fills in the name, icon and colour.

profilesDeleteBody.message: This permanently deletes its history, cookies, saved passwords, extensions and settings from this computer. Passwords kept in a password manager such as Proton Pass stay in your vault.

profilesVsContainersBody.message: A profile is a separate browser with its own data and extensions. Containers separate cookies inside one profile, but share its history, extensions and settings.

profilesKeyHint.message: Press 1 to 9 to open a profile. Shortcut: Alt+Shift+P

err_invalid_avatar.message: Choose one of the icons offered.

err_invalid_color.message: Choose one of the colours offered.

err_no_window.message: Open a browser window and try again.

err_disabled.message: Profiles are turned off in this browser.

err_unregistered.message: Switching profiles is not available in a window started with --profile.
